entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. My order number is VF-881-902.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF-881-902. I see an order for a VeloBand Pulse. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not broken, I just don't want it. It's not what I thought it would be. I want to send it back.
I understand. I'm just checking the delivery date here... It looks like the VeloBand was delivered to you on December 15th, which was 23 days ago.
And? So what? I want to return it.

I'm afraid I won't be able to process a return for this item. Our return policy for the VeloBand Pulse is 10 days from the date of delivery. Since it has been 23 days, it is unfortunately too late to start a return.
WHAT?! That's insane! Your policy is 90 days! I read it! Are you trying to scam me?

I can see how that might be confusing, sir. The 90-day policy applies to apparel like jerseys. However, for wearable electronics that have direct skin contact, we have a much stricter timeframe. After this long, for customer safety and hygiene reasons, we cannot accept the product back.
Hygiene? I barely wore the thing! This is a complete ripoff! That's a pathetic excuse. I want to speak to your manager right now. Put them on the phone.

I am the highest point of contact for this type of policy decision, and the outcome would be the same. The return window is firm. This is a mandatory health and sanitation policy for all VeloBand Pulse devices, and there are no exceptions.

This is garbage service! I'm going to post about this everywhere. Twitter, Facebook, all the cycling forums! Everyone will know how VeloFit scams its customers with a fake return policy! Just give me my money back!

I'm sorry you're frustrated, but I am unable to override this specific company policy. The system physically prevents me from generating a return authorization because it is simply too late. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Useless! Absolutely useless! You've just lost a customer for life!
I understand your frustration. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
